text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Jun ◇, Post-Race | Wind: Ominous "Where 
Will We Wash Ashore?" 
========================================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
It's done! I've finished my Debut race!
It 
might not have met the Trainer's 
expectations, but racing is all about 
having fun.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Keep this up, and it's on to the GⅠs, and 
then the world! ...Or so I'd like to say, 
but my navigator says it's too early.
Hmm, aren't we supposed to share the same 
dream?

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we'd better check our
chemistry 
right now.
To see if we can really make it 
as a team, that is.
